title: The Sora feed philosophy
summary: Discover the Sora feed philosophy—built to spark creativity, foster connections, and keep experiences safe with personalized recommendations, parental controls, and strong guardrails.
body: Discover the Sora feed philosophy—built to spark creativity, foster connections, and keep experiences safe with personalized recommendations, parental controls, and strong guardrails.
summaryZh: OpenAI介绍了Sora信息流的设计哲学，旨在通过个性化推荐、家长控制和严格的安全护栏来激发创意、促进连接并确保体验安全。

aiReview.reasonZh: 文章仅介绍Sora信息流的个性化推荐与安全护栏等产品哲学，无实质模型技术更新。
